snippet.title: Escape Academy 2: Back 2 School - Summer Game Fest 2025 Announcement Teaser
snippet.description:
WISHLIST TODAY: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3296060/

Class is (back) in session with Escape Academy 2: Back 2 School! Explore an all-new campus, escape life-threatening puzzle rooms, and unravel a conspiracy as old as the school itself — all before the bell rings. Play solo or grab a friend and start solving in online or local co-op.
